essay: Many students prefers online learning because it saves travel time. They can watch lessons again and study at their own pace. However, learning at home also have problems. Some students feel lonely, and others find it hard to ask questions. In my opinion, schools should combine online classes with meetings in the classroom. This would give students more choice while helping them stay connected. A school could try one online day each week and ask students what worked well. The results would help teachers decide whether the change should continue.
check_focus: 主谓一致、具体建议、局部纠错、保留原意

essay: School uniforms can make mornings easier, but students should still have some choice. A simple uniform reduces the pressure to buy fashionable clothes. It may also help families plan their spending. On the other hand, a strict rule can be uncomfortable for students who need different sizes or fabrics. Schools should therefore offer several affordable options. They could also hold a clothing exchange at the start of each term. This approach would keep the practical benefits of a uniform while allowing students to feel comfortable. Listening to students and families would make the policy easier to follow.
check_focus: 表达正确时避免凑错、合理改进、无修改全文

essay: I do not think that every student should be required to volunteer at weekends. Many students already help their families or work part-time. They may not have enough free time for an extra duty. This does not mean that volunteering is unimportant. I enjoyed helping at our local library last summer, and I learned how to explain things patiently. Schools could introduce different opportunities and let students choose whether to join. They should also recognise the work students already do at home. A flexible plan would encourage useful service without putting unfair pressure on busy students.
check_focus: 否定立场和事实忠实度、可选润色

essay: Our town need a better bus service. At the moment, the last bus leaves before many evening activities finish. Students who doesn't have a car often depend on their parents for a lift. A later service would give these students more independence. It could also reduce the number of short car journeys. However, running empty buses would waste money. The council should first test a later bus on Friday evenings and count how many people use it. If the service is popular, it could be extended to other days. This small trial would provide evidence before a larger decision is made.
check_focus: 多错误作文、数字与缩写、建议针对性

essay: A community garden would be a useful addition to our neighbourhood. People could grow vegetables, share tools, and learn from one another. Older residents might enjoy meeting new neighbours, while children could see how food grows. The garden would also need clear rules. Someone would have to organise watering during holidays and make sure paths stayed safe. Before starting, the community should find volunteers and agree on a small budget. A garden will not solve every local problem, but it could turn an unused space into a place where people work together.
check_focus: 总体结构反馈、不要虚构未出现的事实

essay: Reading for ten minutes a day may seem like a small habit, yet it can make books easier to finish. I used to choose very long novels and stop after a few chapters. Now I keep a short book in my bag and read while I wait for the bus. This routine is easier to maintain because it fits into time I would otherwise spend on my phone. People should choose books that interest them instead of treating reading as a competition. Regular reading can be enjoyable when the goal is to understand a story rather than reach a large number of pages.
check_focus: 亮点与肯定、反馈不必强制包含错误
